title: Hantavirus cluster linked to cruise ship travel, Multi-country
text: Hantavirus cluster linked to cruise ship travel, Multi-country. A total of eight cases, including three deaths, have been reported. Six cases have been laboratory-confirmed as hantavirus infections, with all identified as Andes virus (ANDV). As of 8 May 2026, four patients are currently hospitalised. The cases are linked to cruise ship travel on the MV Hondius. Travel period: 29 December 2025 to 10 May 2026.
